image_description: A close-up photograph of a Brown Pelican perched on a wooden piling. The bird is in a resting posture with its head tucked back against its body, causing the long neck to form a tight curve. The distinctive large bill and gular pouch are visible, extending diagonally across the frame. The plumage shows a mix of brown, grey, and white feathers, with darker flight feathers visible at the tail end. The background is a uniform, out-of-focus grey sky.
